registration.statement: For each registered H2 or D2 channel, the B-prime threshold terminates in one ground-state atom and one 2s atom, while X-state ground dissociation terminates in two ground-state atoms. Their shared ground-atom prefix cancels structurally, so D0(M2) is exactly the B-prime threshold after the held atomic 1S-2S separation is Taken. This relation is sealed without measured values; only afterward does the complete threshold, atomic and historical/later ground-dissociation vector test it exactly.
registration.title: Exact H2/D2 ground-state bond-dissociation path relation
